> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Contributor Assignment Agreement Version 1.2 acceptance is required for external contributors when required by the workflow.**
> Pull requests authored by the exact repository-owner GitHub login are exempt, including internal Codex work through that account. No title, branch name, commit message, body text, or bot identity grants an exemption.
> When acceptance is required, the GitHub account that opens this pull request must personally complete both acceptance steps below. A maintainer, bot, or another GitHub user cannot accept on the contributor's behalf.
>
> **WHEN REQUIRED, YOU MUST SAY THE CAA ACCEPTANCE STATEMENT IN A NEW TOP-LEVEL COMMENT AFTER OPENING THIS PR.** Checking the box alone is not enough. The comment must be posted by the exact same GitHub account that opened the pull request, or the CAA check will fail and the PR must not be merged.

## Summary

## Contributor Assignment Agreement

Complete this section only when required by the workflow. It compares the PR author's GitHub login exactly with `github.repository_owner`; owner-authored PRs require neither a checked acceptance box nor an acceptance comment. Other authors must complete both steps. Bots have no automatic exemption.

Read the [PistachioSwap Contributor Assignment Agreement Version 1.2](https://github.com/parsij/PistachioSwap/blob/main/CONTRIBUTOR_ASSIGNMENT_AGREEMENT.md).

### Step 1: check the acceptance box

The contributor who opened this pull request must personally check the box below.

- [ ] I have read and agree to the PistachioSwap Contributor Assignment Agreement Version 1.2. By checking this box from my authenticated GitHub account, I intend this action to serve as my electronic signature. I confirm that I own or control the rights I am assigning, have authority to assign them, and understand that this Agreement covers my applicable existing and future PistachioSwap Contributions as described in the Agreement.

### Step 2: YOU MUST SAY THIS IN A PR COMMENT

After opening this pull request, **the same GitHub account that opened it must personally post the exact statement below as a new top-level PR comment**.

**Do not put this statement only in the PR description. Do not ask a maintainer, bot, repository owner, or another account to post it. Checking the box above does not replace this comment.**

Copy and post this exact comment with no extra text:

```text
I have read and agree to the PistachioSwap Contributor Assignment Agreement Version 1.2. I am the person controlling the GitHub account that opened this pull request. By posting this comment from that authenticated GitHub account, I intend this comment to serve as my electronic signature. I confirm that I own or control the rights I am assigning, have authority to assign them, and understand that this Agreement covers my applicable existing and future PistachioSwap Contributions as described in the Agreement.
```

The CAA workflow verifies that the acceptance comment was posted by the pull request author's **same GitHub login and numeric GitHub user ID**. Comments from maintainers, repository owners, bots, or any other account do not count. If the author's acceptance comment is deleted or changed so it no longer exactly matches the required statement, the CAA check will fail again.
